scope: One incomplete live smoke; artifact review without external or paid calls
evidence_before_attempted_finish: Two metadata-only search responses and two duplicate-search errors; no read-paper results, inspected passages, or returned evidence IDs

claims.claim: PagedAttention uses page-based KV-cache allocation, improves cross-sequence reuse, and reduces fragmentation
claims.reason: No inspected PagedAttention source supported these clauses; E1 was never returned. This does not establish that the general mechanism claim is false.

claims.claim: The target setup needs concurrency, sequence-length, and page-table memory measurements
claims.reason: Reasonable local measurement topics, but E2 was never returned and page-table overhead was emphasized without evidence that it is decisive.

claims.claim: Measure two readers at maximum input/output limits and compare VRAM use with A5000 capacity
claims.reason: E3 was never returned. No experiment ran and no required structured proposed_test was supplied. Missing a one-reader control, fixed configuration, warm-up, stop rule, memory breakdown, and latency/completion measurements.

claims.claim: Two-reader compatibility and page-table memory use are not established by the evidence
claims.reason: True about this run's missing evidence. Repetition does not establish universal absence or repair unsupported findings.

failure_attribution.discovery: Semantic Scholar rate limiting triggered date-sorted arXiv fallback with largely irrelevant metadata; sole opened paper concerns multi-node CPU decoding of ternary LLMs
failure_attribution.model: Repeated identical searches, attempted findings before reading, invented E1/E2/E3, off-target paper selection, and repetitive uncertainty exhausting output limit
failure_attribution.actual_rejection: Request 5 ended with finish_reason=length at 1024 tokens and incomplete literal syntax. Its rejection was a parser rejection before citation or semantic validation.
failure_attribution.harness: Watchdog interrupted the paper reader. Last checkpoint covers 5 requests; ledger covers 8. Eighth completion was recovered separately, never consumed, and contains only a passage-call action.

limitations: One incomplete development smoke cannot establish general Qwen incapability, useful research performance, or fine-tuning improvement. No human review.
